fact_text: The guest said stable Karachi areas such as Gulshan-e-Johar, Gulshan-e-Iqbal, PCHS and Defence have genuine buyers and ongoing sales, but builder bookings in new projects are below their level around 2023.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: The guest expected Karachi's property market to improve in 2026 or 2027, and said the industry was lobbying the government for support.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: Before the change, the State Bank of Pakistan's Mera Ghar Mera Aashiana housing scheme capped loans at 3.5 million rupees (35 lakh), which the guest said was too small to build even a small house.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: After recommendations from the guest's association, the prime minister raised the Ashiyana housing scheme loan limit to 10 million rupees, with two plot categories: 10 marla (250 sq yd) and 5 marla (125 sq yd).
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: Construction cost has risen to about 5,000 to 6,000 rupees per square foot, which the guest attributed to sharply higher material prices.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: A ground-plus-one house of about 2,000 sq ft on a 5 marla (125 sq yd) plot would cost about 10 million rupees (1 crore) to build, according to the guest.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: Beyond construction, a home buyer also pays for plot value, documentation, FBR taxes, utility connection fees and building-plan approval charges, which together push the total cost up sharply.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: In good Karachi societies with water, electricity, gas, boundary walls and development work, a 120 sq yd plot was said to cost at least 5 million rupees.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: In the better societies, a 120 sq yd plot was said to cost 10 million to 15 million rupees, and more in premium locations.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: In Gulistan-e-Johar most 120 sq yd plots are already built up, and a good 120 sq yd plot there costs at least 15 million rupees, according to the guest.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: In the city centre, an old house on a 120 sq yd plot is valued at 15 million to 30 million rupees, and buyers often demolish such houses to build new homes.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: Schemes such as MDA and Hawkesbay have many plots but little development, because basic water, power, gas, roads and sewerage infrastructure has not been provided, so plot values there are lower.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: Apartment prices in Scheme 33, Gulistan-e-Johar and University Road start at about 12,000 rupees per sq ft, and some builders announce prices up to 20,000 rupees per sq ft.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: The price of sand (bajri) per dumper has risen by about 300% over two to three years, from around 8,000 rupees.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: Standard wooden house doors have risen by about 200% to 300% over two to three years, and the cheapest standard door is now about 8,000 to 10,000 rupees.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: Electrical copper wire has risen by more than 200% over two to three years, making it hard for ordinary builders to afford the normal construction schedule.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: PVC pipes used for gas connections and water lines have risen by 200% to 300% over two to three years, and some items by more than 400%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: Imported finishing materials such as marble become much more expensive when the dollar strengthens against the rupee, which the guest said has pushed up Pakistan's construction costs.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: A bag of a good-brand cement costs about 1,300 rupees, and premium brands about 1,500 rupees.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: Cement prices are revised roughly every month, so the cost of a building project can change while it is being built, according to the guest.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: Rebar (sariya) cost about 80,000 rupees per ton around 2023, the guest said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: The guest said that after the Iran-US-Israel conflict Dubai's property market has begun to stabilise, and that overseas Pakistani investors may bring money back to Pakistan's property sector.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: The guest said Pakistan ranks second among buyers of property in Dubai, with more than a billion dollars of purchases.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: Pakistan has a population of about 250 million, which the guest described as the fourth largest in the world.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: The guest argued that property money kept in Pakistan supports a large domestic market, bringing more buyers, tax receipts, industrial activity and jobs.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: The guest advised buyers to visit a society or building in person, check the builder's reputation and market value, and have documents verified by a lawyer or an expert before paying.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: Buyers should check a project's building-plan approval with the Sindh Building Control Authority and the development authority before committing money.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: The guest suggested that builders with a track record of delivering projects should be publicised in newspapers, to help buyers avoid unreliable developers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: The guest called for strict self-regulation by builders' and developers' associations, and for the government to enforce the by-laws of the Karachi Development Authority and other bodies.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: The guest said buyers sometimes face multiple claims on one plot, and possession can be delayed for years, a recurring risk in Karachi's property market.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: In central Karachi plots are very expensive and few are available; the guest said plots of 60 to 80 sq yd may be found, and apartments are the main option.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)

fact_text: The guest named Scheme 45, Bahria Town and DHA City as areas where property investment opportunities exist for buyers with budgets around 1 crore rupees.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Is Now the Time to Invest in Karachi Real Estate? | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-22)
